sql_query:
WITH top_cust AS (
  SELECT
    substr(c.customer_unique_id, 1, 10) AS cust_uid,
    count(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders_cnt
  FROM customers c
  JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  GROUP BY 1
  ORDER BY orders_cnt DESC
  LIMIT 3
)
SELECT
  tc.cust_uid AS cust_uid,
  MIN(c.customer_city) AS customer_city,
  MIN(c.customer_state) AS customer_state,
  MIN(c.customer_zip_code_prefix) AS customer_zip_code_prefix
FROM top_cust tc
JOIN customers c
  ON substr(c.customer_unique_id, 1, 10) = tc.cust_uid
GROUP BY tc.cust_uid, tc.orders_cnt
ORDER BY tc.orders_cnt DESC;
